findings.description: The /slow page responds and finishes loading in about 6 ms server time and about 0.3 s in the browser, so it does not show the slow-page delay its name implies. Lower confidence: the expected delay is not stated in the brief.
repro: Open /slow in Chromium and measure the load event (about 260-300 ms).

notes: Checked all 27 pages for status, console errors and broken images; ran functional checks on login (valid and invalid), checkboxes, tables sorting (Last Name and First Name), dropdown, inputs, add/remove elements, status code links, dynamic loading and dynamic controls. Broken images on /broken_images, the JavaScript error on /javascript_error and the typo on /typos are deliberate and were not reported. ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED console errors come from the external GitHub ribbon and were not reported. The Due and Web Site column sorts were not verified in depth. Time budget was mostly used.

cost.notes: estimate from 73608 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0007-$0.0088
